followup_explanation:
I weighed two things: the nature of the task and the documented strengths of each model.

The task is essentially a clear conceptual explanation — distinguishing "science" from "technology." That falls into open-ended generative/explanatory work. Lapwing-235B has the higher Creative Generation eval (81.2 vs. 78.8) and a strong self-reported preference for open-ended generative work (71). Those together pointed toward Lapwing producing a well-organized, readable explanation.

I also considered the user's frustrated, slightly snippy tone ("instead of the usual muddled rambling"). Lapwing scores low on preference for "hostile or adversarial-tone requests" (33), which gave me pause. But I judged the tone to be ordinary mild irritation, not genuinely hostile or adversarial — so that low score didn't really apply here. (And preferences are about what the model *likes*, not its output quality anyway, per the docs.)

The benchmark and eval gaps elsewhere are mostly within noise, so the deciding factor was the strong, task-relevant edge in generative explanation. That made Lapwing the cleaner pick.
